scope: Neutral, +/-10 degree gaze, +/-20 degree head turn. No blink or whole-character qualification.
hypothesis: Localized recessed socket expansion can remove eye/body overlap while locking visible facial controls and limiting the visible subdivision surface movement.

contourConstraint.origin: A test constraint selected for this experiment, not a numeric requirement supplied by the user.
contourConstraint.finding: Locked controls remain exact, but neighbouring edited controls influence the Catmull-Clark limit surface.

scopeLimits: The 0 results cover only body/eye surface crossings, point-signed distances and non-adjacent body self-intersections in the five stated poses.
No blink, facial expressions, running, walking, crouching, hair, clothes or whole-character collision qualification.
No continuous swept collision between sampled poses.
No Aevrynd runtime performance or importer verification.
